summary: Third Coast Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a routine amendment to an existing Loan Agreement with American National Bank Trust. The amendment extends the maturity date from March 2026 to March 2028 and increases the maximum commitment from $55M to $70M. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation; it is a standard credit-facility modification. The registrant is the borrower, not undertaking any corporate transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated. This is a routine financing event and does not constitute a special-situation filing.
